title: feedSignal - Data API
description: Attach feed signals, like UpDownVote, UserVerified, and Verified, to a feed post or comment. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

FeedEntityId.description: The ID of the Feed entity.

FeedItemId.description: The ID of the feed post or comment. Possible values are: FeedItem FeedComment

InsertedById.description: ID of user who inserted the signal. This is a relationship field.

SignalType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
SignalType.description: The type of signal. Possible values are: UpDownVote UserVerified Verified

SignalValue.description: The value of the signal. For example, for UpDownVote, the value specifies whether the signal is an upvote or a downvote.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<complexType name="FeedSignal">
  <complexContent>
    <extension base="ens:sObject">
      <sequence>
        <element name="CreatedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="CreatedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="CreatedDate" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:dateTime"/>
        <element name="FeedEntityId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="FeedItemId" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="InsertedBy" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="ens:User"/>
        <element name="InsertedById" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="tns:ID"/>
        <element name="IsDeleted" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:boolean"/>
        <element name="SignalType" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <element name="SignalValue" nillable="true" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:int"/>
      </sequence>
    </extension>
  </complexContent>
</complexType>
<simpleType name="ID">
  <restriction base="xsd:string">
    <length value="18"/>
    <pattern value="[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}"/>
  </restriction>
</simpleType>
```
